Billing and Plans
Customers are billed monthly by default. Annual billing is available with a discount.
Downgrades take effect at the start of the next billing cycle.
Refunds are not offered for partial months, except where required by law.
Enterprise contracts may include custom payment terms approved by finance.

Product: InsightBoard
InsightBoard is an analytics workspace for operations teams. It supports dashboards, scheduled reports,
and anomaly alerts. Scheduled reports can be exported as CSV or PDF. The platform retains event data
for 13 months on the standard plan and 36 months on the enterprise plan.

Authentication supports email-password, SSO via S

Authentication supports email-password, SSO via SAML, and SCIM provisioning on enterprise plans.
The public API exposes read-only access for dashboards and reports.

Security and Compliance
All customer data is encrypted in transit using TLS 1.2+ and encrypted at rest using AES-256.
Daily backups are retained for 30 days. Role-based access control is supported.
Audit logs are available on enterprise plans and retained for 90 days.
The service is not described as HIPAA compliant in current public documentation.
